title: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers
layout_note: The overview is a bottom-to-top stack in the left column (Noised Latent, Patchify, DiT Block, Layer Norm, Linear and Reshape, then Noise and Sigma outputs side by side), with a side input path (Timestep t, Label y, Embed) next to Patchify. Two dashed lines fan from the DiT Block's right corners to a full-height rounded panel showing its internals, and two more panels of the same size and layout to the right show alternative block designs.
grouping: Four columns, each titled underneath in plain sans text (Latent Diffusion Transformer, DiT Block with adaLN-Zero, DiT Block with Cross-Attention, DiT Block with In-Context Conditioning). The overview column has no container; the three block columns are tall rounded panels of equal size, the chosen one with a black outline and light grey fill, the two alternatives with a grey outline and near-white fill. A large 'N x' to the left of the DiT Block marks repetition. Colour families by layer type are kept identical across all four columns: blue = layer norm, scale/shift and embedding layers, green = feedforward and linear output, orange = self-attention, red = cross-attention, grey-lavender = inputs and outputs (latent, patchify, noise, Sigma, input tokens).
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with no outline and no shadow; the only outlined box in the overview is the DiT Block (black outline, light grey fill), matching the outline of its zoom panel. Labels are sans serif; tensor sizes (32 x 32 x 4) sit in small type under the latent and output names. Residual additions are white circles with +, and the residual paths are thick black elbow lines along the left side of the panel; the conditioning MLP sends a vertical line up the right side with arrow taps labelled in italic math (alpha, gamma, beta with subscripts 1 and 2) into the Scale and Scale, Shift boxes. No tensors are drawn: latents, tokens and labels are text boxes.
proposed_highlight: The paper's adaLN-Zero block is the only block panel drawn at full saturation with a black outline, and it is tied to the overview's DiT Block by two dashed zoom lines. The alternative blocks keep the same size, colour coding and layout but are rendered in uniformly washed-out tints (fills, text, arrows, outline and title all faded), so the chosen design reads first while the variants stay directly comparable.
lesson: Rejected design variants are drawn at the same size and layout as the chosen one but uniformly faded to pale grey and pastel, so the reader sees the winner first and can still compare structures column by column.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2212.09748); venue ICCV as recorded in refs.json (venue_source semantic-scholar). In the overview, the DiT Block's outlined box repeats the zoom panel's black outline and grey fill, which is the only visual tie besides the dashed lines.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: three DiT block variants as equal-height rounded panels side by side, the chosen adaLN-Zero block in full contrast and the cross-attention and in-context variants faded

relations.form: three equal rounded panels titled underneath (adaLN-Zero, Cross-Attention, In-Context Conditioning), each Input Tokens and Conditioning at the bottom, residual stacks going up, the chosen one first and saturated
two dashed lines fan from the overview's 'DiT Block' to the corners of the adaLN-Zero panel
an unframed bottom-to-top overview column: Noised Latent -> Patchify -> DiT Block (N x) -> Layer Norm -> Linear and Reshape -> Noise and Sigma, with Timestep t and Label y entering through Embed
in the adaLN-Zero panel the conditioning goes through an MLP to a vertical bus on the right that feeds gamma, beta and alpha into each Scale/Scale, Shift box

channels.colour: layer type: blue = norm/scale/embedding, orange = self-attention, green = feedforward/linear, pink = cross-attention, grey = data (latents, tokens); saturation separately marks chosen vs alternative variant
channels.shape: rounded rectangle = layer or tensor; circled plus = residual add
channels.line: solid arrows; heavy black lines for the residual and conditioning paths in the chosen panel; dashed = zoom callout
channels.frame: rounded panel = one block variant; black outline and grey fill = chosen, light grey outline = alternative

quality.strengths: The variants are compared as matched panels with the same bottom inputs, and saturation plus a zoom callout make the chosen block the most salient element; the conditioning path is a straight vertical bus feeding each modulation box from the side, with the signals named at the box.
quality.weaknesses: Faded alternative panels are so light their labels are hard to read in print; the layer-type colour code has no legend; colour saturation is a second meaning stacked on hue; the latents carry shapes (32 x 32 x 4) but no image is drawn.

insights.structure: An unframed bottom-to-top overview column on the left (Noised Latent, Patchify, DiT Block x N, Layer Norm, Linear and Reshape, Noise and Sigma) is followed by three equal-height rounded panels, each showing one DiT block variant, all titled underneath.
insights.data: Tensors are grey-lavender rounded boxes carrying their shape in small text (32 x 32 x 4); timestep and label are small blue boxes feeding an Embed box beside Patchify.
insights.emphasis: The chosen adaLN-Zero block panel has a black outline, grey fill and fully saturated colours, while the cross-attention and in-context panels are drawn in faded grey outlines and washed-out fills, and two dashed lines fan from the overview's DiT Block into the chosen panel.
insights.flow: Every column reads bottom to top with short vertical arrows; residual paths loop up the left side of each block panel into circled plus nodes, and conditioning enters from the right through a vertical line with alpha, gamma, beta labels.
insights.avoid: The faded alternative panels are so light that their labels are hard to read in print; layer-type colours (blue norm, orange attention, green MLP) are never explained by a legend.

arrangement.units: an unframed overview column, then three equal tall rounded panels, one per block variant; the chosen variant outlined in black, the alternatives greyed
arrangement.inputs_as: grey 'Noised Latent' box with tensor size, and small blue 'Timestep t' and 'Label y' boxes; in the block panels 'Input Tokens' and 'Conditioning' boxes at the bottom edge
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; outputs Noise and Sigma boxes at the top of the overview
arrangement.shared: the same layer-type colours across all four columns; dashed zoom lines from the overview's DiT Block to the chosen panel
